_notes: Moonwell Hollow boss + rare loot (2026-10-22). ONE item drops per kill from the pool. item_level = creature level + 3; real loot formulas (tools/build_durotar_content.make).

Maelwyn Blightbloom.name: Blightbloom Staff
Maelwyn Blightbloom.flavor_text: A staff of root-wood, split at the head where a flower should be. The flower is elsewhere.

Maelwyn Blightbloom.name: Moonwell-Stained Robes
Maelwyn Blightbloom.flavor_text: Cloth that went through the Moonwell and came out a different shade of silver.

Maelwyn Blightbloom.name: Hollow-Walker's Boots
Maelwyn Blightbloom.flavor_text: Soft leather soled in root-fibre. They know where the floor is, even where you don't.

Maelwyn Blightbloom.name: Signet of the Withered Grove
Maelwyn Blightbloom.flavor_text: A ring of petrified bark. It does not remember being alive, which may be a mercy.

Maelwyn Blightbloom.name: Hollow's Dream-Register
Maelwyn Blightbloom.flavor_text: Names, dates, and what each sleeper saw. The last column is empty.
Maelwyn Blightbloom.label: Tome (Spi)

Mosshide the Gloomcap Elder.name: Mosshide Bulwark
Mosshide the Gloomcap Elder.flavor_text: A slab of living moss over a stone core. It's damp, and it is very hard to move.

Mosshide the Gloomcap Elder.name: Gloomcap Bracers
Mosshide the Gloomcap Elder.flavor_text: Mail bracers with a pale fungus growing between the links. It is, somehow, load-bearing.

Mosshide the Gloomcap Elder.name: Elder's Spore Pendant
Mosshide the Gloomcap Elder.flavor_text: A dried gloomcap on a leather cord. It smells like a cellar and hums like a hive.
